messages:
sam_support: FYI AcmeHealth reporting intermittent 502s on /v1/streaming/completions since ~09:20 PST. Request id r-0a1b2c3d. Happens on long-lived streams (~10-20m). I have partial logs, attaching soon.

jamal_sre: @sam_support can you paste the raw frontdoor/envoy logs + upstream ids? any pattern by client ip or model? :eyes:

sam_support: logs: ```[09:20:12] prod frontdoor request_id=r-0a1b2c3d upstream_response=502 upstream_cluster=ingress-frontdoor reason="connection error: stream reset"``` envoy stats look high for cx_destroy on ingress cluster.

maya_ingress: seeing similar for a different tenant earlier this morning. Suspect HTTP/2 keepalive/window leak - sockets end up half-closed. Can someone tcpdump a failing connection? Repro curl we used: ```curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streaming -d @payload.json``` payload is a long chat with streaming: true.

alex_platform: envoy cluster stats we grabbed: ```# curl http://localhost:9901/stats | egrep 'ingress.*cx_destroy|upstream_rq'
ingress_frontdoor.cx_destroy: 126
ingress_frontdoor.upstream_rq_502: 89
ingress_frontdoor.upstream_rq_504: 12```

lena_oncall: I'm going to rolling-restart frontdoor pods in us-west-2 one at a time to clear stale connections. Starting now, ETA ~20m. @jamal_sre please monitor.

jamal_sre: adding hypothesis: older envoy build mishandles HTTP/2 GOAWAY with active streams -> window bookkeeping not cleared -> new streams attempt to reuse connection with corrupt state -> upstream reset -> 502. Search for 'GOAWAY has_active_streams' in envoy_main.log.

sam_support: tcpdump excerpt from a failing session: ```10:20:11.123 IP 10.0.1.12.54321 > 10.0.2.7.443: Flags [P.], seq 1:512, ack 1... [RST]``` customer-side RST after a long idle period.

maya_ingress: repro steps we validated: 1) open long-lived streaming session, 2) leave idle ~8-12m, 3) trigger a new request that uses the connection pool -> new request gets 502 almost every time. Consistent with keepalive/window leak.

jamal_sre: mitigation we applied on canary: bumped envoy HTTP/2 connection idle timeout from 15s to 30s and deployed a backported patch for GOAWAY bookkeeping. Rolling plan: canary -> two more nodes -> full region.

alex_platform: customer workaround to reduce impact: set `Connection: close` header to force TCP handshake per request (not ideal but reduces reuse of problematic sockets). Already told AcmeHealth.

lena_oncall: canary restart done for fd-12. Observability: ingress_frontdoor.upstream_rq_502 on canary node dropped from ~18/min to 2/min, cx_destroy decreased. Promoting to two more nodes now.

sam_support: relayed workaround and ETA to AcmeHealth; they asked for postmortem once resolved.

jamal_sre: root cause summary I'll put in PR: edge envoy 1.16.x had an HTTP/2 GOAWAY/stream bookkeeping bug when long-lived streams were present, causing half-closed connection reuse and upstream stream resets leading to 502s. Fix: patch + idle timeout config change + controlled restarts. Attach logs, tcpdump, and repro steps in the PR.

frontdoor-bot: Deploy completed on canary node fd-12 at 10:43 UTC :white_check_mark:

maya_ingress: metrics across us-west-2 now back to baseline, 502s resolved on rolled nodes. Closing escalation unless we see a recurrence. :thumbsup:
